platformSummary: Windows (x64) and Linux (x86_64, with glibc or musl) are supported. Release 2.0.2 was tested before publication on Windows, and its release workflow installs it from the release bundle on Ubuntu and Alpine. Its public install was proven on Windows on 2026-10-29.
extensionSummary: The Chrome Web Store serves Chrome adapter v2.0.1. Compatibility is recorded in compatibility.json. Install the extension from the public listing.
